_comment: Source of truth for physical world scale. Version 0.4 uses 65.5km continent tiles so eight zone bands have regional space, plus a 65.5km central sea reserved for Bruma, island chains, routes, encounters, and naval exploration.

bruma.name: The Bruma
bruma.notes: Mysterious central waters of the Luna Sea -- storm-prone, magically anomalous, avoided by ordinary sailors. Midpoint of the sea gap between Valora's east coast and Seradia's west coast.
